launch.readGrants: Only the exact positional test entry, owner, pure contract and package file; no directory, wildcard or historical test read grant.
limits: Permission Model is a trusted-code restriction, not a malicious-code security boundary or OS/network sandbox.

No process.exit or forceExit was used to manufacture successful cleanup.

coverage.legacyV2: Eight preserved lifecycle scenarios, sixteen immediate/deferred rejected-native-store-Promise cases and six read/close reentry cases against the current actual owner/contract.

coverage.primaryCorrection: Only one stale bootstrap comment per new derived suite was corrected before saving. Worker original plan/handoff and old predictions remain retained; assertion/scenario content was not changed by primary.

Exact original/intent binding; no-intent control; current versus historical funding ambiguity; valid-checksummed other-original intent refusal; retained unknown and no authority.

Full frozen global catalog validation before foreign filtering; malformed foreign key, order, duplicate, nonfrozen array and overcapacity refusals; first absence/recovery, second loss, drift, close and unavailable capability.
